data.title: Question Words — Starter · Lesson 2
data.subject: questions
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
Here we go.

[Hook]
Rain is falling… Llueve afuera
Inside my home… En mi hogar
In the morning… En la mañana
Let me show you… Déjame mostrarte
What to say today.

[Verse]
What time is it?… ¿Qué hora es?
Time to learn a little more.
What do you want to eat?… ¿Qué quieres comer?
I'm feeling hungry, can't you tell?
Where is the bathroom?… ¿Dónde está el baño?
I need to know right now.
Who are you going to the movies with?… ¿Con quién vas al cine?
Tell me, do you have a friend?

[Hook]
Rain is falling… Llueve afuera
Inside my home… En mi hogar
In the morning… En la mañana
Let me show you… Déjame mostrarte
What to say today.

[Verse]
What do you need the book for?… ¿Para qué necesitas el libro?
I want to read a story tonight.
Since when do you live here?… ¿Desde cuándo vives aquí?
This neighborhood is so nice.
How much does the ice cream cost?… ¿Cuánto cuesta el helado?
I have some coins to spend.
Why are you happy today?… ¿Por qué estás feliz hoy?
Share your joy with me.

vocab.en: What do you want to eat?
Who are you going to the movies with?
What do you need the book for?
Since when do you live here?
How much does the ice cream cost?
